benchmark.name: Elder free-confirm fixed defect corpus
benchmark.scope: The free-model empty-answer confirmation path, not every Elder backend or review path.

corpus.definition: Twenty-four invented source diffs each have one planted defect and a clean twin. Documentation hunks pad each diff to the size where short empty answers are untrusted.

metric_definitions.defects_caught: Defect cases with a finding on the defective source file.
metric_definitions.false_positives_per_clean_pr: Clean cases with at least one finding divided by scored clean cases; each clean case represents one PR.
metric_definitions.time_to_verdict_seconds: Per-case elapsed wall time from review request to parsed verdict. The current evaluator does not record this.

missing_requirements: This lane has no network. A live evaluation needs a reachable model backend and its configured credential.
The checkout is shallow at 0c334344084acb3e8fb75480934478f579a6749c, so it does not contain the pre-epic revision.
The evaluator does not record per-case verdict duration; timing instrumentation is needed for that metric.
A comparable two-revision run needs one fixed model selection; the evaluator discovers free models by default.
